messages:
zoe: Heads-up — onboarding demo hit a weird rerank regression after switching to the new embeddings endpoint. Some docs items float to top incorrectly and several duplicates appear. error: `EmbeddingDimError: got 2304 expected 1024`

ryan: yikes. which sampleapp / retriever combo?

zoe: Java sampleapp (spring) calling C# retriever microservice. API returned 2304 floats for model=ultra-2304. Java SDK reads `data[0].embedding` fine. C# SDK exposes `vectors` as nested arrays in a struct and the retriever's batch-merge step in C# was written to normalize to a hardcoded 1024 dim for legacy reasons. It silently truncated during merge and produced wrong cosine distances. Also, because of an auth refresh, the retry path in C# merges retried requests into the same batch which triggers the truncate path. Java retry path was separate which created duplicates in candidate set.

maria: can you paste the relevant log lines?

ci-bot: [2175001115] 401 Unauthorized POST /v1/embeddings req=onboard-77
ci-bot: [2175001116] token refresh ok
ci-bot: [2175001117] retry POST /v1/embeddings req=onboard-77 -> 200

zoe: logs:
```text
2025-01-17T09:02:00Z retriever.cs: INFO batch 101 expected_dim=1024 received 4 responses
2025-01-17T09:02:01Z auth.cs: WARN 401 for /v1/embeddings
2025-01-17T09:02:02Z auth.cs: INFO token refreshed
2025-01-17T09:02:02Z retriever.cs: INFO merge retry into batch 101 real_dim=2304 -> normalizing to 1024
2025-01-17T09:02:03Z rerank.java: INFO computed score id=abcd score=0.05
```

kai: so 3 things colliding: different response shapes (flat vs nested), model dim change, and inconsistent retry/merge semantics across SDKs.

ryan: short-term fixes: 1) make batcher fail-fast when real_dim != expected_dim (opt-in flag), 2) preserve raw vectors until validation step (no silent truncation/padding), 3) require Idempotency-Key so retried requests are deduped before merge, 4) canonicalize SDK outputs to resp.data[i].embedding = float[] in each language.

maria: i'll patch the Java sampleapp to set EXPECTED_DIM env and add strict validation + add Idempotency-Key on retry. will also add quick note in onboarding docs about model upgrades.

zoe: i'll open a small C# PR to stop truncating on merge and to map nested `vectors.values` -> `embedding` in the SDK layer. i'll also add an env flag STRICT_EMBED_DIM=true that errors on mismatch.

ryan: good. we'll also add a unit test that simulates 401->refresh->retry and asserts no duplicates and no truncation in both Java and C# paths.

ci-bot: [2175001135] created issue platform#4522 label=devex/embeddings (add cross-SDK dim tests + canonicalize shapes)

maria: workaround snippet to share with customers: 
```java
// java sampleapp
var vec = resp.data().get(0).get("embedding");
if (vec == null) vec = resp.data().get(0).get("vectors");
if (vec.size() != CONFIG.EXPECTED_DIM) throw new RuntimeException("embedding dim mismatch: " + vec.size());
httpClient.defaultHeaders().put("Idempotency-Key", reqId);
```

kai: PRs incoming: github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-dotnet/pull/44 (defer-validate-preserve-raw + map vectors->embedding), github.com/redwood-inference/sample-apps/pull/412 (java: strict-dim + idempotency).

ryan: after patches we should add an onboarding checklist item: verify EXPECTED_DIM after any model change, and turn on STRICT_EMBED_DIM for critical rerank flows.

zoe: thanks all — moving to follow-up. will sync with docs and devex to add the FAQ. :rocket:
